notes: Sound effects: a new Sounds tab with 50 original effects (whooshes, pops, clicks, impacts, risers, glitches and more). Click to hear one, then drag it onto the timeline or press + to add it at the playhead.
Slow motion and speed up: select a footage piece or b-roll clip and pick a speed from 0.25× to 4×. It plays at that speed straight away.
Slip and Roll tools: Slip (Y) shows a different moment of a piece without moving it, and Roll (T) drags a cut between two pieces. Trim start and Trim end now have buttons too.
Mute and hide tracks: every track header has a speaker to mute it and an eye to hide it.
Timeline settings: turn snapping, the magnetic timeline, looping, follow-the-playhead and filmstrip thumbnails on or off. Loop now repeats the whole video when no range is marked.
